**ON BLOCKS OF DELIGNE’S CATEGORY Rep(St)**

*JONATHAN COMES AND VICTOR OSTRIK*

43 pp, 19 sections.

**Abstract.** We describe blocks in Deligne’s category Re p(St).

**Outline.** 1 Introduction; 2.1 Motivation; 1.1 Terminology and notation conventions; 2 The tensor category Rep(St); 2.3.; 3 Indecomposable objects in Rep(St); 3.2 Lifting objects; 3.5 Dimensions; 4 Endomorphisms of the identity functor; 4.1 Interpolating sums of r-cycles; 5 Blocks; 5.1 Blocks in additive categories; 5.2.; 5.5 Proof of result on blocks; 6 Description of a non-semisimple block; 6.2 Comparison of non-semisimple blocks in Rep; 6.3 Description of blocks via Martin; Appendix A. On lifting idempotents
